remarks: Settle into this 1 bed/1bath in beautiful East Norwalk. This is the first floor unit that features beautiful hardwood floors, 9+ foot ceilings, original wood pocket doors, new washer/dryer, and enclosed front porch. Rent includes gas and water. Perfect for commuters, block away from East Norwalk Train Station and I95. Walk or bike to all East Norwalk & SONO amenities, beaches (Calf Pasture & Shady), shops, restaurants, SoNo nightlife, Maritime Museum & Aquarium, the SoNo Collection Mall. Must have good credit and references. Come and enjoy the East Norwalk lifestyle and convenience of being so close to SoNo. Private parking in back and additional parking on street. Submit rental application, credit report, employment verification, photo ID & references through Rent Spree application or Tenant screening service your office uses. Tenant must carry insurance and provide proof. Available July 1 with possibility of earlier move in date. Amazing location! This is the first floor apartment in a two family house. Tenant recently left and the apartment is in the process of being painted. Approx. sq of first floor unit is sub 500sqft.
